# Insomnia fixtures

Insomnia exports (v4 JSON and v5 YAML) copied from Bruno's repository (MIT
license), `tests/import/insomnia/fixtures/` and `tests/import/test-data/`.
Each file's name is its path there, with `/` as `__`. The `malformed` and
`invalid` ones are broken on purpose. They are read by
`tests/insomnia_corpus.rs`.
